sourceDocuments.title: Rural Electrification and Decentralized Renewable Mini-Grids
sourceDocuments.text: Solar mini-grids deploying lithium iron phosphate battery storage systems reduce diesel generator operating costs by seventy-five percent across off-grid rural farming settlements in Niger State.

studentDocument.title: Decentralized Solar Storage in Agrarian Communities
studentDocument.text: Decentralized power is vital for rural cold chain storage. Solar mini-grids deploying lithium iron phosphate battery storage systems reduce diesel generator operating costs by seventy-five percent across off-grid rural farming settlements in Niger State. Local community energy cooperatives manage tariff collections through mobile phone billing applications.
